text.tspan: Online. 41 and 42 were sent, only 41 acknowledged.
If the broker restarted it also lost its record of 42, so it accepts 42 again.
Subscribers drop that duplicate by the origin (publisher, epoch, seq) the message carries.

svg.text: quiesce: write the unacknowledged entries (42) with their epoch and seq
the old connection is fenced: whatever it delivers late is ignored
retransmit the unacknowledged, in order: 42 then 43, same epoch and seq
42 already accepted? acknowledge it again. 43 is new: accept it
PublishRequestAck(42) and PublishRequestAck(43), each for its own message
